_comment: The skills actually available in this Claude Code session, with descriptions trimmed to what a decision model needs. Regenerate with scripts/build_catalog.py when the skill set changes.

skills.code-review: Review a diff, branch or PR for correctness bugs, plus reuse, simplification and efficiency cleanups
skills.simplify: Review changed code for reuse, simplification and efficiency, then apply the fixes. Quality only, not bug hunting
skills.security-review: Security review of the pending changes on the current branch
skills.run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working, or screenshot it
skills.init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file documenting a codebase
skills.claude-api: Must be consulted before answering any question about Claude or Anthropic model pricing, rate limits, model ids, context windows or API parameters; never answer those from memory
skills.update-config: Configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json: hooks, permissions, env vars, automated behaviours
skills.fewer-permission-prompts: Scan transcripts and add an allowlist to settings.json to reduce permission prompts
skills.loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval
skills.schedule: Create, update, list or run scheduled cloud agents on a cron schedule
skills.workflow-authoring: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script: script API, resume, quality patterns
skills.dataviz: Design guidance for any chart, graph, plot, dashboard or data visualization in any medium
skills.artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for building an Artifact page
skills.artifact-diagramming: Diagramming know-how for Artifacts and inline SVG that stays legible in both themes
skills.artifact-capabilities: Runtime capabilities a published Artifact page can be granted: live data, shared state, storage, identity
skills.anthropic-skills:docs: Create a living shareable document, memo, spec, PRD, runbook or write-up that people comment on and edit
skills.anthropic-skills:docx: Create, read or edit Word documents (.docx) and templates (.dotx)
skills.anthropic-skills:pptx: Create, read or edit PowerPoint presentations (.pptx, .potx)
skills.anthropic-skills:xlsx: Create, read, edit or fix spreadsheets (.xlsx, .csv, .tsv), clean messy tabular data
skills.anthropic-skills:pdf: Read, extract, merge, split, fill, encrypt or OCR PDF files
skills.anthropic-skills:skill-creator: Create a new skill from scratch, edit or optimize an existing skill, run evals on skills
skills.anthropic-skills:consolidate-memory: Reflective pass over memory files: merge duplicates, fix stale facts, prune the index
skills.anthropic-skills:import-memory: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory
skills.anthropic-skills:schedule: Create or update a scheduled task that runs automatically on a recurring basis
skills.anthropic-skills:explain-usage: Explain where this session's tokens went, with a chart
skills.anthropic-skills:morning: Render the user's morning brief as a styled artifact
skills.anthropic-skills:setup-claude: Guided setup: install role-matched plugins, connect tools, try a skill
skills.figma:figma-design-to-code: Implement, build, port or code up a Figma design as code
skills.figma:figma-use: Write actions in a Figma file via the Plugin API: create or edit nodes, variables, components
skills.figma:figma-generate-diagram: Create a diagram in FigJam: flowchart, architecture, sequence, ERD, state machine, gantt
skills.figma:figma-generate-library: Build or update a design system in Figma from a codebase: variables, tokens, component libraries
skills.figma:figma-code-connect: Create and maintain Figma Code Connect files mapping components to code snippets
skills.figma:figma-create-new-file: Create a new blank Figma design, FigJam or Slides file
skills.figma:figma-implement-motion: Translate Figma motion and animation into production application code
skills.figma:figma-shaders: Create or edit a shader effect or procedural shader fill in Figma
